Alright, let me think through this year's plan. I've been doing this 40 years, so mostly I go with what works, but I pay attention when the extension站 (station) folks come around.

**My fields.** I've got 15 mu total. I keep about 5 mu in cotton on the sandier ground out west — cotton doesn't fit the wheat-maize rotation and I've always kept some cotton because the price swings differently from grain, so if one is bad the other might carry us. The other 10 mu I do wheat-maize double crop like most people around here.

**Wheat (10 mu).** I'll plant around October 10, right after I clear the maize stalks. I use improved seed I buy from the agricultural supply shop — saving seed doesn't work so well with these new varieties. For fertilizer, the extension guy talks about soil testing and precise rates, but I don't bother with that. I put down compound fertilizer before planting — about one bag (50 kg) per 1.5 mu, that's my base. Then at jointing in March I topdress urea, maybe 15 kg per mu if the wheat looks yellow, less if it's green and strong. Total nitrogen works out around 17 kg/mu, roughly. I irrigate 3-4 times with the well — overwintering if it's dry, then jointing, heading, and grain fill. Pumping isn't cheap so I skip a round if it rains enough. Last few years I've gotten about 450 kg/mu, I'm hoping for similar.

**Maize (10 mu).** Right after wheat harvest in mid-June I've got maybe 5-7 days to turn the field. I don't till much — I just use the no-till planter my neighbor hires out, plant directly into the wheat stubble. Hybrid seed, costs me around 80 yuan/mu. Base fertilizer goes down with planting, then I topdress urea at the big-trumpet stage. Around 15 kg N/mu total. Maize in summer usually gets enough rain so I only irrigate once or twice if there's a dry spell. I expect 500 kg/mu.

**Cotton (5 mu).** Cotton is more work — my wife and I handle it ourselves but at harvest I might pay a couple of neighbors for a few days. Plant late April after the soil warms up. I use about 14 kg N/mu, split base and after squaring. Two irrigations usually, at flowering and boll fill. I spray insecticide 2-3 times for bollworm, herbicide once early. Expect about 250 kg/mu of lint. The picking is what kills me at my age, honestly I think about dropping cotton but the price has been okay and I know this ground.

**Labor and cash.** My son works in town, my wife helps me in the busy seasons. With 15 mu I can't afford to over-spend on inputs — every yuan matters. I buy fertilizer when the price dips in late summer if I have cash.
